newsitem.title: USA: Clorox says expects 1998 to be strong year.
newsitem.headline: Clorox says expects 1998 to be strong year.

text.p: Clorox Co said Wednesday it expects fiscal 1998 to be "another strong year" with its domestic businesses performing well and its international business achieving growth and better margins.
The company said it expects to continue a high rate of new product introductions, and it will continue to increase its advertising investment to support its brands.

Clorox reported earnings of $1.44 a share for the fourth quarter compared to $1.28 a share for the same period a year ago. Full year earnings per share, after an $0.11 dilution, were $4.83 compared to $4.28.

The company said its growth in earnings for the year was a result of high level of shipments, improved margins for its U.S. and international operations, and the benefit of cost reduction initiatives.
Sales overseas, including exports, accounted for 16 percent of its total sales, up from 14 percent last year. The company said that number is on track with its target of 20 percent by the year 2000.
